en: Everyone! Gather 'round!

We all here? Good! Then let's bow our heads
and pray to Atua.

You're a real pain in the ass, ya know that!?
Just tell us what you fuckin' want!
Alrighty then, check this out.

That is a peculiar-looking flashlight...
So, what of it?

Umm, I dunno what it is either.
I inspected it pretty good...

Nyahahaha, but in the end I couldn't figure
it out.
You couldn't?
So I asked someone for help.
...You don't mean—

If somethin' has you worried, just let
Monokuma take care of it!

If you don't know something, I'll tell you.
If you need help, I'll help you.

If you don't like something, I'll fix it. So don't
get rid of it... Please don't get rid of...me.

Very bad when lady who act like that
preys on you.

Huh? Do you know that from 
personal experience?
Tell us, Monokuma. What is this flashlight?
Why, that's a <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
A...Flashback Light?
Flashback?
Light?

That flashlight doesn't shed light on darkness,
it sheds light on your <CLT=cltSTRONG>lost memories<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Lost memories...?

You guys seemed concerned that you couldn't
remember how you came to this school...

But if you use that <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>, you can
remember everything!
What...? With this light?

So it's your fault we don't remember 
when we were kidnapped, huh?

What did you do to us, and how did you
steal our memories away?

Hmm, maybe if you use the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
you'll be able to remember that, too.

...I don't believe it. No way this flashlight will
recover our memories.

I bet there were a lot of naysayers and skeptics
when the telephone was invented, too.

For your information, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL> can
treat various symptoms of <CLT=cltSTRONG>memory loss<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

The light it emits stimulates the basal ganglia
and hippocampus. Not just that, but physical—

Phew, I didn't realize how boring it would be
to explain. Basically, it works like that...

Hey! Don't just give up on explaining
after a single sentence!
So...what should we do?

What should we do...? You mean, should we
or should we not use the flashlight?
No way! I refuse! It reeks of fishiness!

Yeah. Gonta no can believe flashlight can
bring back memory.

Well, why not ask someone who knows machines?
We've got the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Inventor<CLT=cltNORMAL> right here.

You're all a bunch of Ultimate Dumbasses!
No fuckin' way that thing can treat amnesia!

Then again...these aren't exactly <CLT=cltSTRONG>normal
circumstances<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

So in such an uncanny environment as this, 
common sense has no place.

Well, I mean, there are those neuralyzer things.
The flashy things from Men In Black...

Why are you talking about a movie?
This is real life.
Y-You're right... Sorry.

I...don't think we should do it... I'm scared it
might cause some weird side effects...

Nyeeeh... I'm worried how it will 
affect my magic.

...Has everyone spoken? If we're in accord,
I will consent as well.

What about you, Shuichi? You have not
said anything yet.
What? Ah, I—
Alright! Then it's decided! Let's use it!

Huh? Who decided that? We were all 
saying how dangerous it sounds...
Geez, you guys are way too cautious.

I mean, I understand why. We're in such 
a weird situation, after all.

But...we can't win by just running away 
all the time!
<CLT=cltMIND>...What?

If you want to win, you've gotta be 
a little reckless sometimes.

If we can't face this danger, there's no way 
we'll be able to defeat Monokuma.

Kehehe... Well, aren't you confident? But you've
no idea *how* we're supposed to win, do you?

Yeah, I've got no clue.
But still...

If you wanna win, you gotta make a stand 
somewhere or you'll never move forward.

If we run away, our kids will grow up to be the
kinda people who run away from things like this!
...Huh? What are you talking about?

If you still wanna run away, then go ahead.
I won't stop you or blame you.
Okaaay, fine. Then, let's go—

...Huh? What's wrong, everyone?
Aren't we going?
I'm...staying.

After hearing that degenerate's speech,
running away would just frustrate me!

Gonta also stay...
Is what true gentleman would prolly do.

I also agree with Kaito. Our defeat is 100%
assured unless we stand up to this.

That's...how I feel, deep inside.
Just a whisper—

You hear it in your ghost? I'm pretty sure
robots don't have ghosts, though.
...Leave me alone.

I shall stay as well. I suspect I will be able 
to observe something most interesting...

If anything happens to me, y'all better beg my
fans, the world, and humanity for forgiveness!
So what are you gonna do, Shuichi?
I-I... I'll stay behind too.
Alright!

I'll stay, too! So what if it might cause some
weird side effects? That's no big deal!

It seems everyone agrees with Kaito.
Very well, I shall follow suit.

Hmph, *now* it's decided.
Hurry up and do it.
Then I'm gonna turn it on!
Yeah...please.
Click!

<CLT=cltMIND>At the moment that Angie
flicked on the light...
<CLT=cltMIND>The world...
<CLT=cltMIND>Warped...

<CLT=cltMIND>A lightning bolt in my mind shattered
my consciousness like shrapnel.

<CLT=cltMIND>Like a video in fast-forward, scenes
played out in the back of my head.

<CLT=cltMIND>When the pieces of my psyche
had gathered together again...
I...remember...
I remember now!

<CLT=cltMIND>I was...running away.
I had been running this entire time...
<CLT=cltMIND>From...the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>Those of us with <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltMIND> talents
were hunted down. I wasn't safe anywhere...
<CLT=cltMIND>Eventually...I had no place else to run.

<CLT=cltMIND>I was cornered, and to escape from
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>I threw away my <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate<CLT=cltMIND> talent
to live as a normal high school student.

<CLT=cltMIND>By erasing my talent and my memories,
I no longer had any reason to be hunted.

<CLT=cltMIND>If I didn't do what I did, I would have
been captured, a fate worse than death.
<CLT=cltMIND>And so...I chose.

<CLT=cltMIND>I chose to gamble on a new technology
developed in a particular <CLT=cltSTRONG>facility<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>Technology that could put your memories
to sleep by controlling your brain waves.

<CLT=cltMIND>I used that to hibernate all
<CLT=cltSTRONG>memories relating to my talent<CLT=cltMIND>.
Yes, I remember everything now!

In order to escape the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
I erased my own memory—
W-Wait! Did you say "<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>"!?
...Huh?
You guys, too!?

So it wasn't just me getting chased down in
this <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

Yes, you were not the only one. I...no, we...
were being chased as well.

<CLT=cltMIND>We looked around at one another,
each of us with the same shocked expression.
<CLT=cltMIND>What Kirumi said was true...

<CLT=cltMIND>We were all the same. We were all running
from the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltMIND>.

All of us here were being chased by 
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
What on Earth does that mean?

Oh, wait... Can someone tell me what that is?
I...can't seem to remember.
What is the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

Geez, how could you forget something so 
important? Alright guys, the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL> is...

Huh? What was it?
Why can't I remember?
I can't either...
<CLT=cltMIND>I suddenly realized...

<CLT=cltMIND>I could not remember any important
details of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltMIND>...

It's no use, I can't remember either.
I can only remember being chased...
I can't remember anything else at all.

Yeah, no matter how hard I try,
I can't seem to remember—
I...don't want to live...
I want to die with everyone else...
Ah!

<CLT=cltMIND>What...was that?
"I want to die with everyone else"?

<CLT=cltMIND>I...remember saying that,
but why did I say it...?
Umm... It's no use. I can't remember either.

Ugh, this feels gross. Like a shit that won't
fully squeeze out.

Even if we can't remember, we should 
still be able to figure something out...
...Hm? What you mean?

If we were all running from the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>,
then why are we imprisoned here?
Huh? Why?

Could the reason be that...we were 
caught by the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
<CLT=cltMIND>Caught...by the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltMIND>?

You mean, we tried to escape by erasing our
memories, but they found us anyway...

And subsequently, we were captured as part
of this <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
Then, this killing game is...

Yeah... It might be the work 
of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

If that is so...then I am all the more concerned
about this <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

But, but how disappointing!
No one can remember anything!

Nyahahahaha!
What a disappointing disappointment!
Quit laughin' about this, you little shit!

It seems losing <CLT=cltSTRONG>him<CLT=cltNORMAL> made a far bigger impact
than we expected.
...Him?

Rantaro... He seemed to know more than he
let on.

Hey, I have a question.
This might sound a little weird, but...

Does the term <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>
ring a bell for anyone?

Ohhh, I do sorta remember him saying
something like that.

Hmmm... Our mild-mannered mystery man
said that, huh...?

But then...why did only Rantaro remember
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>?

There is no point discussing that now.
After all, he is already dead.

But if you truly wish to hear his words, 
I could perform a seance for you. Hmhm~♪

S-Stop it! Don't bring up weird stuff like that!
And why're you acting girly all of a sudden!?
Yep, death can be real heartless.
Says the root of all evil...

Puhuhu... Looks like you guys safely got
your memory back.

What the hell's goin' on, you stupid-ass bear!?
This <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL> makes no goddamn sense!

Looks like your <CLT=cltSTRONG>sealed memories<CLT=cltNORMAL> are more
stubborn than I thought...

Just one use of the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL> wasn't
enough to restore all of your memories...

You're such a terrible liar. You totally did
that on purpose.

What connection do you have with the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Hunt<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
Puhuhu... I can't reveal that.

Regardless of my true identity, my goal is
crystal clear.

And that is, to make you guys participate in
the killing game! That is my only desire!

<CLT=cltMIND>The killing game...
That's what it always comes back to...

Wh-What!? Killing game!? I will never do that
ever again!

We just gotta work together. If we cooperate,
we'll make it out of here alive.
Just like a certain <CLT=cltSTRONG>someone<CLT=cltNORMAL> said...
<CLT=cltMIND>...Kaede.

But I believe cooperating with each other is
the most logical course of action—
*snore* I'm snooooring!
...Why are you sleeping!?
Whoa! Huh, what!?

Hey, Kokichi...we're having a serious 
conversation here.

And is it written somewhere that I have to
take serious conversations seriously?
Tch, quit acting so immature!

Hm? I'm a teenager...so duh, I'm immature.
Aren't you guys forgetting to act your age?
But I don't have a biological age...

Don't worry about it, Keebo. I'm just talking
to the humans right now!
...Grgh!

What were we talking about again? Something
about working together to escape, right?

So you *were* listening, you horrible
degenerate.

We don't have to work together, though.
Let's just ask how we can get out.

If we ask Monokuma, he'll say the only way
is to win the killing game.

Oh, we're not gonna ask Monokuma. We're
gonna ask the mastermind among us.
...What?

A-Are you already goin' senile!? I thought we
agreed that there is no mastermind?
Hm, oh yeah. We did, didn't we?

If we tried to sniff out a mastermind again,
we'd just repeat Kaede's screwup.
You'd better quit messing around!
Eh? You think I'm messing around right now?

Aw man, you really don't get it. I'm trying
to get this through to everyone...

If you keep saying all this uplifting stuff about
<CLT=cltSTRONG>working together<CLT=cltNORMAL> and <CLT=cltSTRONG>cooperating<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

...then you can expect to receive some
painful retaliation. Get it?
What are you suggesting, Kokichi?

Argh, that's enough!
I'm gonna slug him!

Aaahh! He's gonna punch me!
I gotta make a break for it!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi said his piece and then dashed
as fast as he could out of the room.
Tch...damn, he's fast.
Geez...what a strange guy.

He just provokes people and never says 
anything from the heart.

He's always messing around and 
making fun of those around him.

Hmph! How can he say such insensitive things
when we're trying so hard to survive!

It's like he doesn't even want to survive.
Though, I guess I'm no different.
What?
Yeah. I don't plan to survive till the end.
Ryoma...

You not plan to survive?
What that mean?

He has mentioned that before... That he has
no reason to live.
He doesn't have a reason to live?
Poor Ryoma...

It seems he's got a more tragic past 
than we could even begin to imagine...

Yeah, but the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Tennis Pro<CLT=cltNORMAL> shouldn't 
be saying such cowardly stuff...
Perhaps we should relax over a meal?

Everyone, could you please tell me your
favorite foods and beverages?

Huh!? You're going to whip something up!?
Kirumi, are you, like, the perfect mom!?

<CLT=cltMIND>After we finished the meal that
Kirumi prepared for us...
<CLT=cltMIND>we decided to return to our rooms.
